title: Error-related negativity beyond response timing
disposition_reason: A complete fixed-eight-person descriptive contrast producer and legacy195-field reconstruction scorer exist. An additive matched-FCz numerical-error companion now measures the scientific estimand with exact support commitments; generated controls establish its arithmetic only. Correctness/hand/congruency/RT are exposed analysis covariates, not hidden prediction labels. The repaired RT core still cannot use the originally admitted protected reference binding.

scientific_target.question: What is the error-minus-correct FCz response contrast after prespecified hand/congruency stratification and reaction-time matching, and does the same analysis reveal ocular or pre-response alternatives?
scientific_target.known_answer: Independently recomputed participant matched FCz amplitudes, support and nuisance contrasts for the fixed analysis; the true contrast may be negative, zero, positive or unsupported.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Released response-locked EEG plus observed response-error/hand/congruency/RT covariates; the protected reference is a computation from those observations, not the manuscript effect sign.
scientific_target.case_unit: One full participant packet with all eligible trials and paired comparison, then the required complete eight-person report.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Eight fixed people: sub-001..sub-007 and sub-010; matched trials are repeated observations within person.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Descriptive observational conditional contrast in this selected cohort. Correctly computing it is measurable analysis skill; matching does not randomize errors or establish causal error processing.
exclusions: No held-out label prediction/generalization, exact ERP paper reproduction or native waveform-understanding conclusion from matching195 reference fields.
No positive/sign-matching reward; null, reversed and insufficient-support results are legitimate.

inputs: For each person: up to512 eligible trials, float64[n,3,1024] epochs, channels FCz_reref, HEOG_bipolar and VEOG_bipolar, native EEGLAB amplitude, offsets -614..409 at 1,024 Hz.
Public analysis covariates response_error, response_hand, stimulus_congruency and integer rt_samples205..1024 (200..1000 ms eligibility), opaque trial identities and fixed sample axis.
forbidden_inputs: Protected numerical reference/report, prior candidate report/score and outcome-dependent modifications to matching, channels/windows or support threshold.
Original correctness labels are not forbidden here: they are required exposed grouping variables for this descriptive investigation. They would be forbidden in a distinct error-prediction task.
observation_contract.case_identity: Pinned analysis PEOPLE requires sub-001,002,003,004,005,006,007,010; each trial ID is person prefix plus24 hex characters and all eight packets are mandatory.
observation_contract.split: No train/test split or hidden query in the existing investigation. Freeze estimand and analysis before the selected fixed-cohort packets; any later generalization study requires a separately selected cohort and cannot inherit this reconstruction result.
observation_contract.coverage: Eight full participant packets;195 required report fields comprise58 numeric fields and137 support/digest/disposition fields. Their number is not a count of independent scientific targets.

primary.name: matched_FCz_participant_macro_mae (additive understanding-metrics-v1 companion)
primary.aggregation: Absolute candidate-minus-reference matched-FCz contrast error per person, then equal mean over all eight people, in native_EEGLAB_amplitude. Exact counts, four-stratum support, pair digests and support status must match the reference. If any reference person has fewer than10matched pairs, complete-cohort primary is null; supported-subset errors remain diagnostics only.
primary.rationale: Directly evaluates the neural estimand without137support fields dominating a mixed agreement score or signed errors cancelling. The companion leaves the original195-field calibration grade unchanged and requires an independently admitted matching reference.

secondary: All58 numeric-field errors reported separately, including matched HEOG/VEOG, pre-response FCz placebo and RT matching quality.
Original195-field tolerance agreement remains a named legacy calibration score: numeric tolerance1e-9+1e-7*abs(reference), no effect-sign gate.
Exact eligible counts, stratum support, pair digest and supported/unsupported dispositions are required correctness checks.

comparators.name: Pinned deterministic matched-contrast algorithm
comparators.inputs: Same complete public packets with error/hand/congruency/RT exposed.
comparators.procedure: Within each of four hand×congruency strata, maximize pair count then minimize RT L1 distance within 25 ms; compute0..102 sample mean and error-minus-correct contrast. This implemented computation is the reference estimand, not a competitor biology result.

comparators.name: Unmatched FCz and matched ocular contrasts
comparators.procedure: Retain unmatched FCz, matched HEOG/VEOG and -512..-410 sample FCz placebo as explicit nuisance/selection checks, never tune their windows after inspecting effects.

comparators.name: Fixed zero-contrast predictor
comparators.inputs: No EEG-derived estimate; zero matched-FCz contrast for each of the same eight reference people.
comparators.procedure: Companion reports equal-person mean absolute reference contrast only when all eight are supported. This is a fixed numerical competence comparator, not an assumed biological null or effect-sign requirement.

nuisance_controls: Match within response-hand and stimulus-congruency strata with25 ms RT caliper and deterministic ID tie-breaking.
Require at least10 matched pairs per person; aggregate only if all 8supported.
Report ocular and pre-response contrasts, RT imbalance and matching support; these diagnostics do not prove no residual confounding.
Use source response-marker clock/native amplitude; independently verify pairing/filtering/baseline history before physiological timing claims.
evaluation.uncertainty: Between-person SD/sqrt8 is descriptive in the existing code. Neither trial pairs nor195 report fields are independent participants; no calibrated population or causal interval is established.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require one exact complete8-person report; finite numeric values only when support threshold is met, otherwise null; exact candidate/reference counts, strata, pair digest and support status. Preserve unsupported and reversed effects. The companion rejects support disagreement and validates the entire candidate before opening reference bytes, but is operator-only arithmetic, not an authorization path. Current repaired-core/original-reference protected grading remains held until independent admission.
